The '''Emergency Powers Act''' or '''EPA''' was an amendment to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]] passed in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]]. It eliminated term limits for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]], giving each Chancellor the option of when to stand down for new elections. The act also granted powers for chancellors to make instant decisions without the need for full [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senate]] approval, giving [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] all necessary authority to attempt to end the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], including declaration of martial law on local systems.

The Senate granted the chancellor special powers for the duration of the emergency, yet Palpatine himself was the only person who had the authority to declare the emergency over.<ref name="RotsNovel">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>
